title: Roles & permissions
description: Define what each role can see and do.
pageDescription: Control what each role can see and do. A user's access is the combination of all their roles.

list.title: Roles
list.members: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {# member} other {# members}}

scopeHelp.own: Permissions apply to the user's own records only.
scopeHelp.team: Permissions apply to the user's own records and their direct reports.
scopeHelp.organization: Permissions apply to every record in the organization (HR roles).

modules.employees: Employee directory, profiles and employment details.
modules.personal_data: Identity documents, Iqama, passport, family and emergency contacts.
modules.bank: Salary, allowances and bank account (IBAN) details.
modules.insurance: Medical insurance policies and member cards.
modules.documents: Employee documents, uploads and expiry tracking.
modules.requests: HR requests: submitting, viewing and processing.
modules.approvals: Approval queues and approve / reject / return decisions.
modules.leave: Leave requests, balances, adjustments and calendars.
modules.certificates: Certificate generation, templates and issued letters.
modules.reports: Operational and compliance reports and their exports.
modules.settings: Organization settings, master data and configuration.
modules.audit: Audit log and email log (read-only history).
modules.users: Portal accounts, registrations, roles and permissions.
